title: Billing enquiry guidance
disclaimer: FICTIONAL TRAINING CONTENT. Created for Fictional Telecom Lab; does not represent any real provider or legal requirement. Knowledge guidance only; no customer actions can be performed.

sections.heading: Reading a fictional bill
sections.text: Compare the billing period, recurring plan charges, one-off items and any adjustments. A partial billing period may explain a different amount, but the copilot cannot determine the cause of a real bill without approved account-specific evidence.

sections.heading: Unrecognised charges
sections.text: Ask which type of charge needs explanation without collecting account numbers or payment details in chat. Refer disputed charges to the Fictional Billing Review Team for investigation; do not promise a credit.

sections.heading: Payment and waiver limits
sections.text: The copilot cannot process a payment, waive an outstanding bill, change a due date or confirm that an adjustment has occurred. It can explain these enquiry steps.
